data.name: Lonely Penguin
data.detailed_description:
ONE GOAL: BE THE FIRST TO REACH THE SUMMIT — AND SAVE HIM!

Deep in Antarctica, there is a lonely penguin who has lost all hope, waiting for death at the top of a mountain.
Time is running out. The cold creeps into your bones.
Will you be the hero who pulls him back… or will it be your friends?

Lonely Penguin brings competition and cooperation together in a freezing, unforgiving atmosphere.
When the 60-minute countdown begins, you’re not only racing against nature —
you’re also racing against the players beside you.

RACE AGAINST TIME — PROVE YOUR FRIENDSHIP

Reach Him First

Do everything you can to be the hero who reaches the penguin at the summit, embraces him, and carries him back to his flock.
This is a race — the fast survive, the slow disappear into the snow.

Save Your Friend

The parkour is ruthless. One mistake can send you tumbling into the abyss.
Your only hope is your friends.
They can pull you back up… or leave you behind and continue toward the penguin.
The choice is theirs.

Challenging Vehicle Mechanics

You won’t make it on foot alone.
Use specially equipped vehicles to cross frozen lakes and steep cliffs.
But be careful — speed can be fatal. One wrong move, one rollover, and it’s over.

Co-Op Struggle

Play solo or with up to 3 friends.
Will you move together… or sacrifice each other to be the one who claims the penguin first?

60-Minute Time Limit

The penguin’s heart can’t endure much longer.
If you fail to complete the mission and reach the safe zone within one hour, everything ends.

At the top of that icy mountain, every second is a decision.
Will you reach out a hand to your friend — or leave them behind on the path to the penguin?

Time is ticking.
Save him… or witness him die alone in the cold.

⏱️ 60 MINUTES — ONE CHANCE

When the countdown starts, it never stops.
Fail to reach the penguin within 60 minutes, and it’s over.

A wrong path, a small fall, a moment of hesitation…
Each one leads to irreversible consequences.

🤝 CO-OP: WHO’S FASTEST?

Play alone or enter Antarctica with up to 3 friends.

But one critical question remains:

Who will save the penguin first?

  • Each player chooses their own route

  • Takes their own risks

  • Sets their own pace

Even when playing as a team, one thought lingers in everyone’s mind:
“Who will reach him before the 60 minutes run out?”

data.short_description: A lonely penguin waits for death at the summit, and you only have 60 minutes to reach him. Conquer Antarctic trails, drive vehicles, and race to be the first to rescue him. If you fall, your friends can save you; but time is running out in this icy desert. Don't leave him behind!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Windows 8
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 or Radeon HD 7970
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.
  • Processor: Windows 10
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
